books.title: The Energy to Heal: Find Lasting Freedom From Stress and Trauma Through Energy Medicine Yoga
books.author: Lauren Walker
books.description: Lauren Walker's third book builds an Energy Medicine Yoga programme around the five elements, with step-by-step practices for working through the stress and painful experiences that stay held in the body. It combines yoga postures with energy work so readers can respond to triggers more calmly and build resilience. Published by Llewellyn.

courses.title: The Energy to Heal
courses.description: A week-by-week online course that follows the five elements of her book of the same name, starting from a foundational template practice. Each week pairs yoga postures with tapping, acupressure holds, tracing of energy pathways, breathwork and organ sounds, aimed at releasing the emotional hold of stress and past trauma.

free_resources.title: Release Your Stress in 5 Easy Ways (free masterclass)
free_resources.description: A free hour-long recorded class teaching five simple Energy Medicine Yoga moves to settle the body's stress response. It explains how stress and trauma show up in the body and how energy practices can bring it back to balance.
